Sneak and right click: empties the cylinder very fast, with a lot of spread.
enchantment.copperslug.revolver_carambol: Bullets bounce off blocks. They always bounce off copper.
enchantment.copperslug.revolver_desenfun: The first shot right after drawing the revolver is critical and dead accurate.
enchantment.copperslug.revolver_senalero: Flares last twice as long and make whatever they light up glow.
pistola.copperslug.girado: You spun the cylinder: you don't know which one is next
pistola.copperslug.ayuda1: Right click: shoot · Looking straight down: at your temple (Russian roulette)
pistola.copperslug.ayuda2: Sneak + right click with ammo in the other hand: load (with honeycomb: wax; with an axe: scrape)
pistola.copperslug.ayuda3: Sneak + left click: spin the cylinder · Sneak + right click a player: duel
pistola.copperslug.oxido.1: The revolver's copper is now exposed
pistola.copperslug.oxido.2: The revolver's copper is now weathered
pistola.copperslug.oxido.3: The revolver is fully oxidized (wax it with honeycomb)
pistola.copperslug.ruleta.vacia: Click. You got away with it... this time.
pistola.copperslug.ruleta.fogueo: BANG! ...it was a blank. Still alive.
pistola.copperslug.duelo.aceptar_ayuda: Click to accept (or sneak and right click your challenger with the revolver)
pistola.copperslug.duelo.retado: You challenged %s. Waiting for them to accept...
pistola.copperslug.duelo.sin_reto: %s hasn't challenged you (or the challenge expired)
pistola.copperslug.duelo.ocupado: One of you is already in a duel
pistola.copperslug.duelo.resultado: ★ %s won the duel against %s (drew in %s s)
pistola.copperslug.duelo.tablas: Duel tied: nobody hit in time
item.copperslug.escopeta_presion.tolva_v: Empty hopper: fires a blast of air
item.copperslug.escopeta_presion.ayuda1: Hold right click to pump; left click fires. Don't go past the red!
item.copperslug.escopeta_presion.ayuda2: Sneak + right click: suck in items and pull mobs
item.copperslug.escopeta_presion.ayuda3: In the inventory, right click with shells: into the hopper · honeycomb: wax · axe: scrape
Good old buckshot: lots of damage up close
item.copperslug.escopeta_cartucho_incend: Sets targets on fire and lights campfires, candles and TNT
item.copperslug.escopeta_cartucho_escarc: Freezes, slows, puts out fire and leaves powder snow
item.copperslug.escopeta_cartucho_miel.a: Sticky: slows a lot and stops jumping
item.copperslug.escopeta_cartucho_sal.ay: No damage: it stings and pushes (slimes really hate it)
item.copperslug.escopeta_cartucho_semill: Sows and fertilizes in a cone. The farm shotgun
item.copperslug.escopeta_cartucho_confet: Party! For the jukebox or the fair
item.copperslug.escopeta_cartucho.cargar: Right click it onto the pressure shotgun to load the hopper
enchantment.copperslug.escopeta_compreso: The pressure shotgun holds more before bursting (and hits harder).
enchantment.copperslug.escopeta_valvula_: The pressure shotgun no longer bursts: at the top it vents the air by itself.
enchantment.copperslug.escopeta_doble_ca: One pumping is enough for two shots.
enchantment.copperslug.escopeta_fuelle.d: The air blast and the suction reach further and pull harder.
enchantment.copperslug.escopeta_reciclaj: Gravel, salt or seed shells are sometimes not used up.
item.copperslug.rifle.ayuda1: Hold right click: look through the spyglass
item.copperslug.rifle.ayuda2: Left click: fire (with no round ready, works the bolt)
item.copperslug.rifle.ayuda3: Sneak + left click: work the bolt by hand (loads the ammo in your offhand); while aiming, takes a photo
item.copperslug.rifle.ayuda4: Honeycomb or axe onto the rifle in your inventory: wax or scrape the copper
item.copperslug.bala_trazadora.ayuda: Leaves a trail and makes whatever it hits glow
item.copperslug.bala_cuerda.ayuda: Strings a zipline to wherever it hits; take it down with shears
msg.copperslug.rifle.cuerda_lejos: The rope doesn't reach that far (max %s blocks)
msg.copperslug.rifle.cuerda_tope: There are too many ziplines in this world already (%s)
msg.copperslug.rifle.cuerda_lista: Zipline strung: %s blocks. Right click it or jump under it to hang on
msg.copperslug.rifle.foto_movil: Photo saved to your phone's gallery
enchantment.copperslug.respiracion_conte: Keep the scope still for 2 seconds and the next shot flies straight, with no drop, and hits harder.
enchantment.copperslug.atravesar.desc: The bullet goes through several mobs and through soft blocks (leaves, glass, wool).
enchantment.copperslug.ojo_halcon.desc: Whatever you keep in your scope for a moment glows for a while for every player.
enchantment.copperslug.tirolinero.desc: Rope bullet ziplines are longer and faster.
enchantment.copperslug.silenciador.desc: Shots are almost silent; sculk and the Warden don't notice them.
msg.copperslug.rifle.colgado: Sneak to brake; you let go at the bottom
advancements.copperslug.armas.cofre.desc: Find a firearm in a chest: the revolver in villages, the shotgun in shipwrecks, the rifle in pillager outposts... and six more out there.
advancements.copperslug.armas.ruleta.des: Put the revolver to your head and hear it go "click".
advancements.copperslug.armas.ruleta_fog: Play Russian roulette with a blank in the cylinder.
advancements.copperslug.armas.duelo.titl: This Town Ain't Big Enough for the Two of Us
advancements.copperslug.armas.duelo.desc: Win a revolver duel: challenge someone (sneak + right-click) and draw faster.
advancements.copperslug.armas.gallina.de: Turn down a duel. Bawk bawk.
advancements.copperslug.armas.sedante.de: Sedate a creature with the revolver's tranquilizer dart.
advancements.copperslug.armas.encasquill: Have a rusty revolver jam on you. Should have waxed it.
advancements.copperslug.armas.salto.desc: Launch yourself with the pressure shotgun's blast of air: lots of pressure, no shells, shoot the ground.
advancements.copperslug.armas.reventon.t: It Blew Up in Your Face
advancements.copperslug.armas.reventon.d: Pump the pressure shotgun until it bursts.
advancements.copperslug.armas.granjero.d: Sow farmland by shooting it with a seed shell.
advancements.copperslug.armas.aspirar_pi: Pick things up off the floor by sucking them in with the pressure shotgun (sneak + right-click).
advancements.copperslug.armas.cuerda.des: Rig a zipline with the rifle's rope bullet, or hang from one.
advancements.copperslug.armas.francotira: Hit a creature with the spyglass rifle from more than 100 blocks away.
item.copperslug.gatling.ayuda1: Right-click the ground: set it up; on a minecart or a boat: mount it
item.copperslug.gatling.ayuda2: Right-click it: take the controls; hold right-click: turn the crank
item.copperslug.gatling.ayuda3: Belts by hand or from a hopper; with redstone it cranks itself (turret); sneak + right-click picks it up
item.copperslug.winchester.ayuda1: "The gun that won the West". Lever after every shot (spun on horseback)
item.copperslug.winchester.ayuda2: Mixes the revolver's rounds and its own in the tube: the last one in is the first one out
item.copperslug.derringer.ayuda1: Two shots. Nobody sees it in your hand until you fire: the ace up your sleeve
item.copperslug.derringer.ayuda2: Anywhere in your inventory, the sleeve key (K) draws it at once, and it hits harder
item.copperslug.thompson.ayuda1: Hold right-click: burst fire (the longer it is, the more it climbs)
item.copperslug.thompson.ayuda2: It's kept in a violin case. Of course
item.copperslug.cargador_thompson.ayuda: 50 rounds for the Thompson (you swap the whole drum)
item.copperslug.estuche_violin.lleva: Has a Thompson inside (that's why it sounds out of tune)
item.copperslug.estuche_violin.ayuda: Sneak + right-click: take the Thompson out; with the Thompson in your other hand, put it away
item.copperslug.mosquete.ayuda1: One heavy shot after the flash in the pan; the bayonet works as a spear
item.copperslug.mosquete.ayuda2: Slow reload with gunpowder and a ball; in the rain, the powder gets wet
item.copperslug.canon_mano.ayuda1: 14th-century cutting-edge tech: right-click lights the fuse
item.copperslug.canon_mano.ayuda2: Two gunpowder and a stone ball, or a falling block (sand, gravel, anvil...). Sometimes it bursts
item.copperslug.bala_pintura.ayuda: Paints wool, concrete, terracotta and glass where it hits (and dyes sheep)
item.copperslug.escopeta_cartucho_goma.a: The balls bounce off walls twice and push hard
msg.copperslug.armafuego.vacia: Click... it's empty (sneak + right-click to reload)
msg.copperslug.armafuego.atascada: Jammed! Sneak + right-click to clear it
msg.copperslug.gatling.al_rojo: The Gatling is red-hot! It jammed (and it burns)
msg.copperslug.gatling.sin_cinta: Out of rounds: load a belt
advancements.copperslug.armas.gatling.de: Fire 40 rounds in a row with the Gatling without letting go of the crank.
advancements.copperslug.armas.gatling_ca: Overheat the Gatling until it jams. The smoke was warning you.
advancements.copperslug.armas.gatling_cu: Cool down a hot Gatling with a water bucket. No RGB lights, though.
advancements.copperslug.armas.winchester: The Gun That Won the West
Fire the Winchester 1873. Lever, shot, lever, shot...
Fire the Winchester on horseback, spinning the lever with one hand.
Hit something with the Derringer right after drawing it. Nobody saw it coming.
advancements.copperslug.armas.violin.des: Open a violin case. What's inside isn't a violin (and neither is that sound).
advancements.copperslug.armas.thompson_t: Empty a whole Thompson drum in a single burst.
advancements.copperslug.armas.mosquete.d: Fire the musket. First the flash, then the bang, then the cloud.
advancements.copperslug.armas.bayoneta.d: Finish something off with the bayonet. No reloading needed for that.
advancements.copperslug.armas.polvora_mo: Try to fire with wet powder. They did tell you.
advancements.copperslug.armas.canon.desc: Fire the hand cannon. Light the fuse and hold on.
advancements.copperslug.armas.canon_revi: Have the hand cannon burst in your hands. There's a reason they went out of fashion.
advancements.copperslug.armas.tiempo_bal: Hit someone with a bullet time round. Everything slows down... except your ego.
advancements.copperslug.armas.goma.title: Pong
advancements.copperslug.armas.goma.descr: Hit a creature with a rubber ball that bounced off a wall.
advancements.copperslug.armas.pintura.de: Paint a wall with one shot of the rifle's paint bullet, or dye a sheep.
advancements.copperslug.armas.atasco.des: Have a brand-new gun jam on you. Even the best ones fail one time in a hundred.
advancements.copperslug.armas.coleccioni: The Good, the Ugly and the Collector
Get all nine firearms. Each one is found in a different structure.
item.copperslug.bala_plata.ayuda: For the Winchester: double damage against the undead (Castlevania approves)
item.copperslug.bala_dinamita.ayuda: For the Winchester: blows up where it hits, without breaking blocks (Red Dead style)
item.copperslug.carta_marcada.ayuda: For the Derringer: whoever takes it glows for everyone and has bad luck
item.copperslug.bala_oro.ayuda: For the Derringer: x2.5 damage. GoldenEye's golden gun, pocket-sized
item.copperslug.tambor_trazador.ayuda: For the Thompson: every round leaves a trail and makes targets glow
item.copperslug.tambor_agua.ayuda: For the Thompson: a 1920s Super Soaker. Puts out fires and soaks endermen
item.copperslug.cinta_incendiaria.ayuda: For the Gatling: rounds that set things on fire
item.copperslug.cinta_palomitas.ayuda: For the Gatling: harmless, and whoever gets hit gets fed. Popcorn for the show
item.copperslug.metralla.ayuda: For the musket: seven pellets in a cone, like the pirates of Assassin's Creed IV
item.copperslug.bola_cadena.ayuda: For the musket: sweeps up to three at once and slows them (the mast-breaker from Sea of Thieves)
item.copperslug.bolano_incendiario.ayuda: For the hand cannon: sets everything around the hit on fire
item.copperslug.bolano_fuegos.ayuda: For the hand cannon: a colourful burst of fireworks (barely any damage)
enchantment.copperslug.gatling_refrigera: Gatling: heats up 20% less per level.
enchantment.copperslug.gatling_cinta_lar: Gatling: each belt holds half as many rounds again per level.
enchantment.copperslug.gatling_engrasada: Gatling: the crank spins up twice as fast.
enchantment.copperslug.winchester_repeti: Winchester: the lever works 15% faster per level.
enchantment.copperslug.winchester_dead_e: Winchester: on horseback, shots fly straight and hit 25% harder (Red Dead style).
enchantment.copperslug.winchester_carga_: Winchester: loads each round 25% faster per level.
enchantment.copperslug.derringer_as.desc: Derringer: the quick-draw trick lasts longer and hits harder.
enchantment.copperslug.derringer_doble.d: Derringer: fires both barrels at once.
Thompson: 25 more rounds per level in the drum.
enchantment.copperslug.thompson_compensa: Thompson: the burst climbs and spreads 25% less per level.
enchantment.copperslug.mosquete_polvora_: Musket: the powder never gets wet, not even in the rain.
enchantment.copperslug.mosquete_carga.de: Musket: the bayonet hits 2 harder per level.
enchantment.copperslug.canon_mecha_corta: Hand cannon: the fuse burns 30% faster per level.
enchantment.copperslug.canon_bien_fundid: Hand cannon: it no longer bursts in your hands.
armafuego.copperslug.oxido.3: The copper is fully oxidized (wax it with a honeycomb)
msg.copperslug.armafuego.ayuda_cobre: Sneak with a honeycomb / an axe in your other hand: wax / scrape
advancements.copperslug.armas.plata.desc: Finish off an undead with a silver bullet from the Winchester.
advancements.copperslug.armas.oro.title: The Golden Gun
advancements.copperslug.armas.oro.descri: Finish something off with a golden Derringer bullet. 007 would be jealous.
advancements.copperslug.armas.carta.desc: Mark someone with a Derringer card. Now everyone can see them glow.
advancements.copperslug.armas.soaker.des: Put out someone on fire (or soak an enderman) with the Thompson's water drum.
Fire popcorn from the Gatling. Nobody gets hurt, everybody gets a snack.
advancements.copperslug.armas.cadena.des: Sweep two or more at once with a single chain shot.
advancements.copperslug.armas.feria.desc: Fire a fairground cannonball from the hand cannon. More fireworks than damage.
advancements.copperslug.armas.patina.des: Own one of the new guns fully oxidized. The museum will want to buy it off you.
item.copperslug.estuche_violin.violin: Right-click: play a note (higher the further up you look)
item.copperslug.bala_hielo.ayuda: For the Winchester: freezes whoever it hits and puts out their fire (Sub-Zero approves)
item.copperslug.bala_humo.ayuda: For the Derringer: a cloud of smoke where it hits, and you vanish for a moment. Ta-da!
item.copperslug.tambor_tinta.ayuda: For the Thompson: blinds for a moment and stains wool, concrete and glass black. Splatoon in a pinstripe suit
item.copperslug.cinta_guisantes.ayuda: For the Gatling: lots of knockback and barely any damage... except to zombies (Plants vs. Zombies)
item.copperslug.bola_arpon.ayuda: For the musket: pulls whatever it hits towards you, or you towards the block (Sea of Thieves' harpoon)
item.copperslug.bolano_saltarin.ayuda: For the hand cannon: bounces three times before it blows up (Angry Birds, medieval edition)
enchantment.copperslug.gatling_torreta.d: Gatling: with redstone and nobody at the controls, it aims by itself at hostiles in front of it. "Are you still there?"
enchantment.copperslug.winchester_deposi: Winchester: 3 more rounds per level in the tube.
enchantment.copperslug.derringer_prestid: Derringer: when drawn from your sleeve, it loads a round by itself if one is missing.
Thompson: 25% more rounds per second per level.
enchantment.copperslug.mosquete_pedernal: Musket: the spark catches sooner and misfires less in the pan.
enchantment.copperslug.canon_polvora_fin: Hand cannon: the ball flies 20% faster per level (and further).
item.copperslug.mosquete.bayoneta_no: No bayonet (fix a sword to it)
item.copperslug.mosquete.ayuda_bayoneta: A sword dropped on it in the inventory (or both in the crafting grid) fixes it; with an empty hand, takes it off
key.copperslug.derringer_manga: Draw the Derringer from your sleeve
advancements.copperslug.armas.gatling_to: Have a hopper feed a belt into the Gatling. No need to even load it any more.
Have the Gatling, powered by redstone with nobody at the controls, hit something hostile. Target acquired.
advancements.copperslug.armas.gatling_va: Fire the Gatling mounted on a minecart. The mine chase, but you've got the machine gun.
advancements.copperslug.armas.gatling_ba: Fire the Gatling mounted on a boat. The Jackdaw would be proud.
Finish off a zombie with the Gatling's pea belt. The Gatling Pea, out West.
advancements.copperslug.armas.winchester: Load four different kinds of round into the Winchester's tube. Every shot's a surprise.
Freeze someone with an ice round from the Winchester. Wins!
advancements.copperslug.armas.derringer_: Draw the Derringer from your sleeve and land a hit within a second. Nobody saw it coming.
Vanish in a cloud of smoke with the Derringer's smoke round. A magician never reveals their secrets.
advancements.copperslug.armas.paganini.d: Play eight different notes in a row on the empty violin case (without the Thompson, it's out of tune).
advancements.copperslug.armas.tinta.desc: Blind someone with the Thompson's ink drum. You're a kid, now you're a squid!
advancements.copperslug.armas.bayoneta_n: Fix a netherite sword to the musket. For the parades.
advancements.copperslug.armas.arpon.desc: Pull something (or yourself) with the musket's harpoon shot. Sea of Thieves again.
advancements.copperslug.armas.yunque.des: Hit something with an anvil fired from the hand cannon. Wile E. Coyote has been trying for years.
advancements.copperslug.armas.castillo_a: Fire a falling block from the hand cannon and have it land where it hits.
advancements.copperslug.armas.rebote.des: Make a bouncy cannonball bounce three times. The green pigs tremble.
